flaky.schedule-once: Schedule checks and writes its KV run record in separate steps, with a lock local to each process. Shared Redis and Postgres stores can run one occurrence more than once. Remove when Schedule claims each occurrence atomically across processes.
flaky.workflow-shared: OpenWorkflow workers race on their schema setup at cold start, so one, two or all three start. #3839 fixes the race. Move it back to the mode lists, or remove it, when #3839 lands.

with-redis.queue-failover: Queue on Node is the local file provider. Jobs that A accepted wait in A's directory after A stops.
with-redis.rate-limit-shared: Rate Limit on Node is forced to the memory driver. Each instance allows 10 per minute.
with-redis.realtime-fanout: Realtime on Node has only the memory authority. Rooms do not fan out across instances.
